stance_rationale: PD32 draft is not admission-grade: the primary package is malformed JSON, and the alpha decision relies on full-sample empirical sign flips that violate PIT-C13/C1. Time-series shape exists, but PIT, universe/liquidity, lockbox, and validation defects are hard blockers.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: PD32 best parquet is multi-date monthly, so RF-A7 is not the main failure. However requested qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260511_001 path is missing; only stage_artifacts/WT_D20260511_001 exists.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: pd32_v3b_compose.R applies manual -1 empirical_sign flips to CR11/INV10/INV09 from full 298-month IC diagnostics; not Z_Score_Aligned-only.
No Usable_Date trail is present for selected factor values; package itself marks C14 PARTIAL.
Scripts read .cache/factor_db/factor_db_YYYYMM.parquet directly via read_parquet rather than load_month_factors().
No live regime/overlay signal is applied in PD32 alpha construction; crisis labels are diagnostics only.
Selected T composite uses CR11/INV10/INV09, not financial-statement factors requiring annual/quarterly lag.

critical_concerns.description: Primary package alpha_package_pd32_draft.json is invalid JSON: parse fails at line 233 due to an unclosed alternatives_considered object. A malformed package cannot satisfy artifact lineage or automated verification.

The selected alpha depends on full-sample IC-based sign flips over 298 months, including 2024-2026. Calling this an academic prior does not cure the lookahead because the factor directions were chosen after observing realized Ret_1m.
C15 and C14 are not procedural details: the PD32 scripts directly read monthly factor parquets and lack Usable_Date evidence, so the PIT chain is not auditable.
The PD32 best alpha artifact has 1,287-3,444 tickers per date and 3,445 unique tickers, far outside KOSPI200 ∪ KOSDAQ150. Liquidity is also not proven at the mandated 20d TV ≥ 2e8 KRW level.

Lockbox separation is not credible: the package reports 8/8 gates on the full 298-month window while the alpha-research decision should be pre-lockbox only. Independent split shows lockbox ICIR 0.268 and post-lockbox ICIR 0.160 versus full 0.366.

Monotonicity is below the alpha gate: pooled decile return ordering has only 6 of 9 upward steps, ratio 0.667 < 0.80, and date-level top-decile > bottom-decile only 62.4%. The package omits this checklist failure.

Multiple-testing control is under-specified. The package counts 14 trials, but the search includes v3 standalone factor mining plus v3b composites; DSR is an IC-proxy z statistic, not a return-based DSR gate.

AX-007 Exception 1 is asserted but not proven for PD32. The package provides a heuristic ICIR-to-SR lift, while Forge/portfolio NAV validation, turnover, cost, and hard 20-name implementation are explicitly deferred.

supporting_arguments: Time-series structure itself is acceptable: PD32 best parquet has 298 monthly sig_dates from 2001-07-01 to 2026-04-01 with no future dates.
Independent recomputation matches reported IC: mean IC 0.0412, ICIR 0.3659, NW t 6.159 over 298 months.
stage_artifacts/WT_D20260511_001/covariance.parquet is PSD with min eigenvalue 0.01217 and condition number 8.81, satisfying the post-shrink cond ≤ 100 check for that 100x100 artifact.
Stage weights schedules have 155 monthly dates and per-date sleeve weights sum to 1, but qepm/mailbox/worktask/WT-D20260511_001/weights.csv itself is missing.
unresolved_disputes: Whether an academic reversal story can replace PIT-safe factor direction alignment for CR11/INV10/INV09.
Whether PD33 expanding-36m rerun preserves the reported IC after removing full-sample sign inference.
Whether the PD32 universe can be reduced to KOSPI200 ∪ KOSDAQ150 with 20d TV ≥ 2e8 without destroying IC and monotonicity.
Whether return-based DSR and portfolio NAV backtest pass after turnover, 15bps cost, and top20 constraints.
weakest_assumption: The single weakest claim is that full-sample negative IC signs for CR11/INV10/INV09 can be treated as ex-ante KR contrarian priors and deferred to PD33 without invalidating the PD32 alpha decision.
rebuttal_required: Produce valid JSON for alpha_package_pd32_draft.json and re-run schema validation.
Regenerate PD32 alpha using Z_Score_Aligned or PIT expanding sign alignment only, with no full-sample sign inference.
Use load_month_factors() and provide Usable_Date <= sig_date evidence for all factor rows.
Rebuild the artifact on KOSPI200 ∪ KOSDAQ150 with 20d TV ≥ 2e8 KRW and report top-decile liquidity.
Report pre-lockbox, lockbox, and combined gates separately; do not use lockbox data for alpha selection.
Add monotonicity diagnostics and explain the 0.667 decile-order failure.
Recompute DSR as return-based DSR after Forge portfolio construction and count all search trials.
Validate AX-007 Exception 1 with actual multi-sleeve NAV, turnover, cost, and ticker-level max-name/weight audits.
rationalization_red_flags: Full-sample empirical sign 사용은 정의상 lookahead-bias 의심. 단 ... 학술 메커니즘이 reversal/contrarian을 지지
PASS expanding-window 가능; 본 PD32는 standalone full-sample IC 사용

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: The main issue is not RF-A7; it is that PD32 has a time-series artifact built from non-PIT sign choices and an unconstrained universe. Forge/Architect validation cannot rescue an alpha source whose construction violates PIT-C13/C15 upstream.

alpha_specific_questions: Can the factor direction survive a true expanding 36m PIT rerun without full-sample IC sign inference?
Can the signal retain IC ≥ 0.04 and monotonicity ≥ 0.80 after restricting to KOSPI200 ∪ KOSDAQ150 and 20d TV ≥ 2e8?
Does a return-based DSR and 5-spec regression remain valid after actual top20 portfolio construction, 15bps cost, and turnover smoothing?
